title: Explain this command
before I run it
content:
Explain what this command does, step by step, and flag anything risky about it:

find . -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -delete

title: Write me a script
that backs up a folder
content: Write a bash script that backs up a folder to another disk. Include a --dry-run flag and explain each part briefly.

title: Review my code
for bugs and edge cases
content: I'm going to paste a function. Review it for bugs, edge cases and unclear naming, then show me a corrected version.

title: Help me debug
a service that won't start
content: A systemd service won't start. Walk me through diagnosing it, starting with the exact commands to run and what to look for in the output.
